message:
Pivot to 0.944 parent: exp_055 LB-flat, exp_057 launched, exp_058 designed

exp_055 (original-score joint repair): completed KEEP, independently audited
(exact local_052 parity). One authorized Public LB scoring returned 0.942 ==
repro_041 -- zero gain; the frozen train16 proxy did not transfer. Decisive
finding: the train16 proxy is unreliable for post-smoothing graph-repair changes.

exp_056 (division-aware joint repair): three Codex REVISE rounds; halted because
its go-gate (exp_055 LB > 0.942) failed.

Pivot to repro_048 (Public LB 0.944) as the research parent, validated by the
leaderboard. exp_057 (0.944 bundle + motion EMA 0.4): built (repro_048 notebook +
only the scoped velocity_um EMA edit + a fail-closed double-pass integrity block
verifying EMA-off byte-parity to 0319ba6d, >=1 canonical edge diff, EMA telemetry,
and effective-alpha==0.4, emitting a controller-compatible metrics.json). Reached
strategy CONSENSUS and Codex admission PASS; launched once as
lingxd/biohub-exp057-0944-motion-ema (SUBMITTED, 1.0 GPU h reserved).

exp_058 (aggressive self-train, v0.3): combined A+B fine-tune with a controlled
held-out split; designed and queued behind exp_057.

Adds HANDOUT.md session record and syncs canonical state (STATE.json, CLAUDE/GOAL/
AGENTS checkpoint blocks, CONTINUATION, SUBMISSION_BUDGET, GPU_BUDGET) plus the
earlier uncommitted exp_053/054/055 work.
